1e1b95f466df42668203c9cbb5b955b0989fbf65.sourceText: 本功能包复制于 `pb2025_robot_description`。为便于复用，将功能包目录命名为 `robot_description`，并将 `package.xml` 的 `<name>`、`CMakeLists.txt` 的 `project()` 和 launch 中的包查找名称同步改为 `robot_description`。
1e1b95f466df42668203c9cbb5b955b0989fbf65.translatedText: This feature package is copied from `pb2025_robot_description`\. To facilitate reuse, the feature package directory is named `robot_description` and the `package.xml` of `<name>`the `CMakeLists.txt` of `project()` and the package lookup name in the launch file are synchronously changed to `robot_description`\.

1e21f6bddbe7ff8cb45aebe4d8de9681b3882e79.sourceText: 因为 `main.c`、`cpp_interface.cpp` 和 `cpp_interface.h` 都在 `src/` 同一层目录下，所以这里使用双引号包含时，编译器可以从当前源文件所在目录找到它。
1e21f6bddbe7ff8cb45aebe4d8de9681b3882e79.translatedText: Since `main.c`、`cpp_interface.cpp` and `cpp_interface.h` are all in `src/` the same directory, when double quotes are used for inclusion here, the compiler can find it from the directory where the current source file is located\.

1e2674a107dd3a3ace3b4e303a69e588509d2b9a.sourceText: PCD读入后，源码查询 `base_footprint ← front_mid360`，再把这个矩阵左乘到**整份地图的每个点**。它按节点当前时间查询，失败后每秒重试，成功一次就继续；没有查询次数上限，也没有在后续云台转动时更新目标地图。
1e2674a107dd3a3ace3b4e303a69e588509d2b9a.translatedText: After the PCD is read in, the source code queries `base_footprint ← front_mid360`, then left\-multiplies this matrix onto **every point of the entire map**\. It queries based on the node's current time, and after a failure retries every second, continuing once it succeeds; there is no upper limit on the number of queries, nor does it update the target map during subsequent gimbal rotation\.

1e6fd4ef1cb1cf63b02091602e35a8b357a0fa98.sourceText: 教程及官方README将scan_topic说明为绝对名称；当前2.6.10订阅实现没有强制这一形式，本工程使用相对名称obstacle_scan，按ROS规则解析。话题名称与消息中的frame_id也是两件事：名称决定接收哪条消息，frame_id决定扫描坐标如何解释。[ROS2话题名称规则](https://design.ros2.org/articles/topic_and_service_names.html)
1e6fd4ef1cb1cf63b02091602e35a8b357a0fa98.translatedText: The tutorial and the official README describe scan_topic as an absolute name; the current 2\.6\.10 subscription implementation does not enforce this form, and this project uses the relative name obstacle_scan, resolved according to ROS rules\. The topic name and the frame_id in the message are also two different things: the name determines which message is received, while frame_id determines how the scan coordinates are interpreted\.[ROS2 topic name rules](https://design.ros2.org/articles/topic_and_service_names.html)

1e76131d899ec4b44d1a5549d8088a6676eb1780.sourceText: 这是我们第一次把函数声明单独放进头文件。`swap.h` 只负责告诉其他源文件：工程中存在一个名为 `swap`、接收两个 `int` 参数的函数。
1e76131d899ec4b44d1a5549d8088a6676eb1780.translatedText: This is the first time we have placed a function declaration separately into a header file\.`swap.h` It is only responsible for telling other source files: there exists in the project a function named `swap`, which takes two `int` parameters\.

1e98055726540cf0095a2bc1f8cfbc01a6b72e4c.sourceText: 在多态中，通常父类中虚函数的实现是毫无意义的，主要都是调用子类重写的内容
1e98055726540cf0095a2bc1f8cfbc01a6b72e4c.translatedText: In polymorphism, the implementation of a virtual function in the parent class is usually meaningless; it mainly calls the content overridden by the subclass\.
